It is the last item EVENT-PROCESSING-SPEC.md deferred out of Wave 5, and the owner has now taken the four decisions it was waiting on. It is the honest complement to the deflation, and the two ask different questions. The deflation asks "how many things did you try?" This asks "how much of it was one lucky name?"
